avis.titre: excellent SPF products for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I purchased the Beauty Screen mineral peptide foundation tint and the Glow Balm, and was gifted the Clear Stick and bag. The Beauty Screen and Glow Balm are incredible-by far the best I have tried in terms of light coverage SPF make-up. The tint provides excellent natural looking coverage and the balm glides on perfectly, with easily buildable, dewey colour. I have not tried the clear stick yet, but based on the other products I imagine it will be perfect for on-the-go SPF applications. These products do not irritate my sensitive skin-they have nourishing ingredients and are breathable. Thank you Naked Sundays!!

avis.titre: Love the product, wish it lasted longer
avis.texte: I absolutely love this sunscreen stick! it's so convenient to apply, mess-free, and perfect for on-the-go use. The texture is smooth, itdoesn't leave a greasy residue, and it blends well without any white cast. it's great for sensitive skin and feels light and breathable. My only complaint is that it runs out faster than I expected. With regular use, I found myself needing to repurchase sooner than I would have liked. It would be perfect if the stick lasted longer!

avis.titre: Wonderful sunscreen that the whole family can use!
avis.texte: This sun stick is awesome. I love it, but I love it even more for my kids, who can apply this to themselves while at day camp! No sunburns have occurred since using it, and it is non-irritating, so they are happy to use it. Most importantly, they reapply throughout the day because it is so easy to use. This is a summer staple for the entire family. You are going to want to buy a few!
